contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ FL IVL CONST[--] ; R/ [GLORIA] EX[ERCI]T[VS]

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantius II (323-361), Gloria Exercitus issue of 336-340, Reece period 17, possibly a contemporary copy. Obverse description: Bust laureate drapes and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: FL IVL CONST[--]. Reverse description: Two soldiers with one standard between them. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA] EX[ERCI]T[VS]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin.…
